title: Hit probability after degree padding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $r$ be a symmetric relation on $	ext{Fin}(n)$. For vertices $s,t$ and an integer $k$, if the probability that a length-$k$ walk in the directed graph defined by $r$, starting at $s$, visits $t$ is at least $9/10$, then the corresponding probability in the padded regular multigraph of degree $	exttt{le\_padDegree}(n)$, after $10n^2k$ steps, is at least $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: The relation on Fin(n) is symmetric
The original hit probability is at least 9/10
caveat: The selected padding degree is specified by the Lean term le_padDegree n, whose definition is not included in the supplied upstream definitions.
